documents.name: Me cabe
documents.message: %(size $(random 30)) %(mensajes[] %['Nombre, por eso no te cabe mas, atasacdo', 'Ya comio, pero como que todavia quiere mas', 'Como que ya se le anda antojando', 'Ya densela por que se muere de hambre']) A $(user) le caben %(size)cm. *(%(size) <= 8 ? %(mensajes[0]) : %(size) <= 16 ? %(mensajes[1]) : %(size) <= 25 ? %(mensajes[2]) : %(mensajes[3]))

documents.name: Shoutout
documents.message: *($(twitch.channel &t) ? $(announcement purple "Check out ${$(twitch.channel &t)} at https://twitch.tv/${$(twitch.login &t)} and give them a follow! They were last playing ${$(twitch.game &t)}") : "Please provide a valid user to shoutout. Usage: !so <username>") *($(twitch.channel &t) ? $(shoutout &t) : "") *($(twitch.channel &t) ? $(show.clip &t) : "")

documents.name: Ponerla
documents.message: $(user) tiene un $(random)% de probabilidad de ponerla esta noche!

documents.name: Memide
documents.message: %(memide $(random 30)) %(mensajes[] %['Jaja, la tiene re chiquita', 'Algo promedio, nada mal', 'Uff, esa si esta grande', 'Seguro que no es una tercera pierna?']) A $(user) le mide %(memide)cm. *(%(memide) <= 8 ? %(mensajes[0]) : %(memide) <= 16 ? %(mensajes[1]) : %(memide) <= 25 ? %(mensajes[2]) : %(mensajes[3]))

documents.name: Follow Age
documents.message: $(user) has been following the channel for $(followage $(user))
$(user) has followed, Welcome to the stream!
Hype train has started! It started at $(hypetrain.progress) and will end at $(hypetrain.end)
Hype train has progressed to level $(hypetrain.level)!
Hype train has ended! It ended at level $(hypetrain.level) with $(hypetrain.progress)% progress!
$(ad.time) seconds of ad break has begun!
$(user) subscribed with $(sub.tier) for the first time!
$(user) resubscribed with $(sub.tier) for $(sub.months) months on a row!
